settings.heading: Questions, answered.
settings.intro: Everything you might want to know about deodorant for sensitive skin — and how AGAIN works.

settings.question: Is it bicarb-free?
settings.answer: Yes — no bicarb and no aluminium. We use magnesium instead.

settings.question: Does it work all day?
settings.answer: It is designed to neutralise odour and keep you feeling fresh through the day.

settings.question: Is there an adjustment period?
settings.answer: Some people notice a short transition when switching from conventional antiperspirants. It usually settles within a week or two, and you can reapply anytime.

settings.question: Will it stain my clothes?
settings.answer: It glides on clear and absorbs in seconds, so you can get dressed straight away — no white marks or residue.

settings.question: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: It's made for sensitive skin. We leave out bicarb, a common cause of irritation in natural deodorants, and use gentle magnesium with shea butter and coconut oil.

settings.question: How does the subscription work?
settings.answer: Choose to receive your balm every 4, 6 or 8 weeks and save 15%. It arrives right when you're running low — no reordering.

settings.question: Can I change my delivery frequency?
settings.answer: Anytime, from your account. Switch between 4, 6 and 8 weeks whenever it suits your routine.

settings.question: Can I skip or cancel?
settings.answer: Yes — skip a delivery or cancel entirely anytime, with no fees and no fuss.

settings.question: When am I charged?
settings.answer: Each order is charged on the day it ships. We'll email you a few days beforehand so there are no surprises.

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Standard shipping is 3–5 business days; express is 1–2. You'll receive tracking as soon as your order ships.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping?
settings.answer: Shipping is on us for orders over $50. Under that, a flat standard rate applies at checkout.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: We currently ship across Australia, with more regions coming soon.

settings.question: What's your returns policy?
settings.answer: We back every order with a 30-day happiness guarantee. If it's not for you, reach out and we'll make it right.

settings.question: What is The Companion?
settings.answer: It is a reusable brass key designed to help get the last of the balm out of its tube.

settings.question: Does it fit the balm tube?
settings.answer: Yes — it's made for the AGAIN balm tube and slots onto its base.

settings.question: Why brass?
settings.answer: It's durable, plastic-free and ages beautifully. One key can last a lifetime of tubes.

settings.heading: Still have a question?
settings.text: Get in touch and we’ll be happy to help.
